text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: A three-phase inverter synthesizes line voltage with complementary PWM bridge legs

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Ideal two-level three-phase bridge, sinusoidal triangle PWM in linear modulation m≤1. Lower gates are exact complements of upper; hardware dead time and
shoot-through protection are not modeled. Pole voltage references DC-link midpoint O; line v_ab is the difference of poles and does not require a neutral connection.
Fundamental line RMS=√3 mV_DC/(2√2)=195.959 V. Load currents, dead-time distortion and antiparallel diodes omitted.
